query:
SELECT
            c.name                 AS "name!",
            SUM(o.amount)::float8  AS "total_amount!: f64",
            COUNT(o.id)            AS "order_count!: i64"
        FROM "order" o
        JOIN company c ON c.id = o.company_id
        WHERE o.serving_date >= $1 AND o.serving_date <= $2
          AND o.status != 'cancelled'
        GROUP BY c.id, c.name
        ORDER BY 2 DESC
